title: [4.4 stable] C# build_assemblies.py not working
body:
### Tested versions

Tested for version 4.4 stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900KF (32 threads)

### Issue description

When trying to build the .NET assemblies using the "build_assemblies.py" it results in errors:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/479e3dc7-3950-4258-895a-8d7ae95e1b28)

The imported project “D:\Projects\04. Custom Godot\godot\modules\mono\glue\GodotSharp\GodotSharpEditor\Generated\GeneratedIncludes.props” was not found. Make sure that the expression in the import declaration “Generated\GeneratedIncludes.props” is correct and that the file exists on the data carrier

When I am checking my folder the files are existing? 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6500929a-f528-4125-a004-7e7f1b68cee0)

I executed the following commands in order:

(in the godot root folder)
1. scons platform=windows production=yes module_mono_enabled=yes

(in the godot/bin folder)
2. godot.windows.editor.x86_64.mono.exe --headless --generate-mono-glue modules/mono/glue

I do not know if this error is relevant
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f20277c4-8f6f-4151-bc84-42ab72f6eed3)

but it successfully generated the C# classes

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d0153aae-4712-43e0-8972-7aa5217db2f2)

(also from godot folder)
3. modules/mono/build_scripts/build_assemblies.py --godot-output-dir=bin

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ad9d3d71-b615-45a0-b52a-09bb664dd368)

### Steps to reproduce

1. download godot 4.4-stable code
2. compile it with mono enabled
3. generate c# glue
4. build assemblies

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

No MRP
